entries.content_osis: <hi type="bold">Verse 31</hi> <div eID="gen13793" type="x-p"/> <div sID="gen13794" type="x-p"/> These likewise cast lots - The Levites were divided into twenty-four orders; and these were appointed by lot to serve under the twenty-four orders of the priests: the first order of Levities under the first order of priests, and so on. The meaning is not very clear: "both elder and younger," says Bishop Patrick, "had their places by lot, not by seniority of houses. They who were of greater dignity drew lots against those who were of less; and were to take their courses according to the lot they drew." This may have been the case; but we are very little interested in the subject.  <chapter eID="1Chr.24"/> <div eID="gen13794" type="x-p"/>
